title: File:The United States Army Concert Band performs at The Capitol in Washington, D.C. on August 15, 2025 - 19.jpg
desc: The U.S. Army Band “Pershing’s Own” performs a concert at The U.S. Capitol in Washington, August 15, 2025. The Concert Band performed selections from film scores and featured clarinet soloist Staff Sgt. Rucha Trivedi. U.S. Army photo by Sgt. 1st Class Brittany Primavera.
